legend.hotness: 0-1 composite: base score x trajectory weight (rising 1.0, steady 0.4, peaked 0.1, falling 0.0) x momentum x stickiness. USE THIS for ranking.
legend.demand: 0-1 demand proxy component (search volume / pytrends value).
legend.freshness: 0-1 recency: 1.0 first seen <24h, decays to 0 over 14 days.
legend.approx_traffic: Raw search-volume estimate from Google Trends RSS when present (e.g. 200000 = 200K+/mo), else null.
legend.state: Trajectory from Google Trends interest-over-time: rising (at/near max NOW, climbing) | steady (evergreen) | peaked (past max, tail dropped >30%) | falling (sustained decline >=15%) | unknown (not yet verified).
legend.slope: Relative interest change: (recent_third - earlier_third) / earlier_third. +0.5 = 50% hotter recently.
legend.verified_by_google_trends: true = interest-over-time fetched and state measured. false = provisional (source signal only, awaiting verification).
legend.source_count: How many independent sources carry this trend. 2+ = corroboration.
legend.seen_count: Times this trend reappeared across harvest cycles. Higher = persistent.
legend.variant_count: Near-duplicate queries clustered under this head (same core terms). Indicates how many ways people search it.
legend.areas: Visual categories with sell rationale; useful=false means no clean nuggets yet.
legend.categories: Same trends grouped: fashion, beauty, interiors, food_drinks, lifestyle.
legend.emerging_early: Twin-signal early candidates (autocomplete + exploding topics) BEFORE Google volume appears.
legend.track_record: Hits/misses of previous 'rising' calls — the agent's prediction follow-up.
